Annual responsibilities included development across approximately 8–15 TCT-related conference, sponsor and partner websites, front-end work for TCT Industry, app features and related interfaces, and production of more than 200 emails each year through Salesforce Pardot for CRF, TCT and participating organizations.

The TCT website was built in Joomla with Bootstrap, jQuery, JavaScript, PHP, SCSS, SVG, HTML5 and CSS. Dynamic schedules and interactive interfaces used technologies including AJAX, RESTful APIs and JavaScript, with responsive email development supporting the larger conference campaign.
